title: Junta Airstrikes and Artillery Kill Four Civilians Across Rakhine State
detail: Myanmar military airstrikes and artillery fire killed four civilians, including three women, across separate Rakhine State townships on September 20, 2026. In Ponnagyun Township, a junta jet fighter dropped two 500-pound bombs on Kala Chaung village in the evening, killing 55-year-old U Saw Thein. In Rathedaung Township's Zee Kaing village, an elderly woman and her 42-year-old daughter were killed by junta artillery fire. In Pauktaw Township, a woman was killed in an airstrike on Taung Phu village; some reports place this strike on September 21.

media.caption: Narinjara News report on four Rakhine civilians killed by junta airstrikes and artillery on September 20.

title: Junta Jet Bombs Taungphu Pagoda, Damaging Major Rakhine Buddha Image
detail: A Myanmar military jet fighter bombed the area around Taungphu Pagoda in Rakhine State around 1:00 a.m. on September 20, 2026, damaging one of the largest Buddha images in Arakan State. No casualties were reported.

media.caption: Narinjara News report on junta bombing damage to the Taungphu Pagoda Buddha image.

title: Arakan Army Ambush Annihilates Junta Column Near Point 948 Hill, Mindon Township
detail: The Arakan Army ambushed and destroyed an entire Myanmar military column near Point 948 Hill, close to Kan Kyo village, in Mindon Township along the Rakhine-Magway border, in intense clashes on September 20-21, 2026. A military source said the junta column was completely annihilated; more than 30 junta soldiers were reported dead. The AA released a statement and photographs on September 22 documenting over 30 seized weapons along with ammunition and military gear recovered from the battlefield.

media.caption: The Irrawaddy report on the Arakan Army ambush near Point 948 Hill, Mindon Township.
